structure.title: Chapter One: Introduction
structure.description: Sets the stage for the research.

subsections.title: Background of the Study
subsections.guidance_notes: Provide context and historical development of the problem.

subsections.title: Statement of the Problem
subsections.guidance_notes: State clearly what the research is trying to solve.

subsections.title: Objectives of the Study
subsections.guidance_notes: List the specific goals the research aims to achieve.

structure.title: Chapter Two: Literature Review
structure.description: Reviews existing work in the field.

subsections.title: Theoretical Framework
subsections.guidance_notes: Identify theories that underpin the research.

subsections.title: Empirical Review
subsections.guidance_notes: Summarize previous studies relevant to the topic.

structure.title: Chapter Three: Research Methodology
structure.description: Explains how the research was conducted.

subsections.title: Research Design
subsections.guidance_notes: Describe the overall strategy chosen to integrate the different components of the study.

subsections.title: Population and Sampling
subsections.guidance_notes: Define the group of interest and how participants were selected.
